name: Pingdom
summary: Pingdom sells one synthetic monitoring plan in quantity tiers, from $16.50 a month on annual billing for 10 uptime checks, 1 page speed or transaction check and 50 SMS alerts. Every tier includes unlimited users and public status pages, with checks at most once a minute.

evidence.capability: http and ping checks from many locations

facts.text: Before logging downtime, Pingdom marks a check as unconfirmed and asks a probe server in another location to repeat it.
Locations are chosen by region group, such as North America or Europe, and Pingdom states that single locations cannot be picked.
Uptime report data is kept from the day a check was first set up.
Turn/River completed its acquisition of SolarWinds, Pingdom's owner, in April 2025.
Pingdom's synthetic pricing page says the first 14 days are free, while its home page offers a 30-day trial.

plans.name: 10 uptime checks
plans.notes: Billed annually ($198 a year); $18 on monthly billing. 1 advanced check and 50 SMS alerts

plans.name: 50 uptime checks
plans.notes: Billed annually; $78 on monthly billing. 10 advanced checks and 200 SMS alerts

plans.name: 100 uptime checks
plans.notes: Billed annually; $149 on monthly billing. 20 advanced checks and 350 SMS alerts

plans.name: 500 uptime checks
plans.notes: Billed annually; $680 on monthly billing. 50 advanced checks and 1,000 SMS alerts

hiddenCosts: Tiers are fixed bundles, so more checks or SMS alerts mean moving to the next tier.
Extra SMS credits can be bought automatically when they run out, at a price the documentation does not state.

contract.cancellation: SolarWinds' SaaS terms renew automatically, ask for 90 days' written notice of non-renewal and give no refunds on termination.
contract.dataExport: Test results as CSV, 10,000 lines per download, plus an API with raw results.
